notes: TWO DISAGREEMENTS WITH THE CHUNK FILE. (1) OFFICE: index.csv leaves office BLANK for this row; the cover's Office line is NOT blank -- it reads verbatim 'Cache County Two'. That is a county-office self-description (the Cache County Council district-two seat, matching JoAnn Bennett's 'Cache County Council district 2' on the same filing wave), so the filing is IN SCOPE as a county office; the office string is quoted verbatim rather than normalized. (2) DATE: the chunk file says 2026-01-07; the form's 'Date', 'Date of Report' (x3 footers) and the electronic 'Signed at:' stamp all read 01-02-2026 / 2026-01-02 11:30:57. Transcribed from the form. Also note the report-type check: the filer marked 'Seven days preceding the General Election', which contradicts the file name's 'PreCon' (pre-convention) label -- the form governs and is reported as-is.
